title: Homelab backups
description: Backup jobs pushed to the Pushgateway by the backup-run wrapper. Status follows the homelab:backup_status rule.

list.name: Failed runs
list.expr:
max by (backup) (
  (backup_last_exit_code{job="homelab_backup", host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup", kind="borg"} >= 2)
  or (backup_last_exit_code{job="homelab_backup", host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup", kind!="borg"} != 0)
)
list.textFormat: Last run exited with an error

panels.title: Status
panels.description:
Overall state from the `homelab:backup_status` recording rule.

- **OK**: last run succeeded and it is on schedule.
- **WARNING**: last success older than 1.5x the interval, borg exit code 1, or a run taking more than 2x its typical time.
- **FAILED**: last exit code is an error, last success older than 3x the interval, or no success recorded.
- **RUNNING**: a run is in progress and nothing else is wrong.
- **NO DATA**: no status for this backup (rule missing or series gone). Treat as failed.

Subtitle: host, kind and target.

targets.expr:
((
  max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"})
  + on (host, backup)
  3 * (max by (host, backup) (backup_running{job="homelab_backup", host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}) == bool 1)
    * on (host, backup) (max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}) == bool 0)
)
or
max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}))
* on (host, backup) group_left (kind, target)
(0 * max by (host, backup, kind, target) (backup_expected_interval_seconds{job="homelab_backup", host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}) + 1)
or on (host, backup)
((
  max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"})
  + on (host, backup)
  3 * (max by (host, backup) (backup_running{job="homelab_backup", host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}) == bool 1)
    * on (host, backup) (max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}) == bool 0)
)
or
max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}))

panels.title: Last success
panels.description: When the last successful run ended (exit code 0, or 0/1 for borg). From `backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds`. Survives failed runs, so a failure shows here as this getting old.

panels.title: Next run due
panels.description: Last start + expected interval. If this reads "… ago", the next run is late (cron didn't fire, or the host is down).

panels.title: Last run took
panels.description: Duration of the last finished run (`backup_last_duration_seconds`). The sparkline is the duration of each run over the selected range.

panels.title: Exit code
panels.description: Exit code of the last finished run. Borg: 0 OK, 1 warning, 2+ error. Others: anything but 0 is an error.

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Successful runs / finished runs in the selected time range (counts changes of the success and end timestamps). Anything below 100% means at least one run failed.

panels.title: Status history
panels.description: Status of each backup over time (same colours as the tiles). Blue bars are runs in progress. Gaps mean no data for that period.

(

    * on (host, backup) (max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"}) == bool 0)
)
or
max by (host, backup) (homelab:backup_status{host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"})

panels.title: All backups
panels.description: One row per backup. Status is the authoritative column (borg exit code 1 is only a warning). Age is time since the last success; Next due is last start + interval.

(

  + on (host, backup)

time() - max by (host, backup) (backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="homelab_backup", host=~"$host", backup=~"$backup"})

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: Duration of the last finished run, per backup (log scale so a 25 s sync and a 40 min borg run fit together). Each step is one run. Red regions are periods where the last run had failed.

panels.title: Exit code
panels.description: Last exit code over time. Green 0; borg 1 yellow (warning); red is an error.

panels.title: Repository size on disk
panels.description: Unique (deduplicated, compressed) size of all archives in the repo: what it actually costs on disk (`backup_borg_repo_unique_bytes`).

panels.title: Last archive size
panels.description: Original size of the data the last archive read (`backup_borg_original_bytes`).

panels.title: New data in last archive
panels.description: Deduplicated size of the last archive: how much new data it added (`backup_borg_deduplicated_bytes`).

panels.title: Repo growth in range
panels.description: Change in repository unique size over the selected time range.

panels.title: Archive size: original vs new data
panels.description: Per archive: data read (left axis) vs new deduplicated data written (right axis). A jump in the right axis means many new or changed files.

panels.title: Repository size on disk
panels.description: Unique size of the whole borg repository over time.
